name: Ealdmaine Caverns: a woman clicking the disguise corpse gets the attire and the Ealdir Disguise credit (#11954, #12021)
contract: Two reports (#11954, #12021): a female character clicking Dead Ealdmaine Ealdir 164225 got the Ealdir attire 365017
and the red error "You are in the wrong zone.", and Ealdir Disguise stayed at 0/1. The existing case uses a man.
Expected for a woman: the attire 365017 and the reaction 365094 are applied and the objective counts.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the corpse is spawned
Let the corpse reach the client
Take Ealdmaine Caverns beside the corpse
the client is told the corpse can be clicked
the Ealdmaine Caverns reaction is applied
and the Ealdir Disguise objective counts
